t: Code is Truth: From Fuzzy Logic to Actuator AI
s: Advocates for running code as the ultimate source of truth over traditional documentation, reframing AI as a powerful actuator translating intent into real-world actions, not just a conversationalist.
sub: Code as the single source of truth vs. documentation
AI as an actuator, translating intent into action
Deeper dive into physics (fuzzy logic to quantum) and its parallels with understanding complex systems
Critique of LLM reliance on documentation and emphasis on embedded code documentation (docstrings)
The philosophical basis of truth and knowledge (Münchhausen trilemma, problem of induction)
